rules.title: Resulting consent state is verified before comparison
applicability_facts: A visitor-facing consent mechanism is present or expected
rules.observable_test: Verify each choice or transition through a documented CMP state surface plus browser differential evidence.
exceptions: Unknown/custom CMP may require analyst-assisted state confirmation

rules.title: Browser behaviour is compared across visitor choices
applicability_facts: Comparable scenarios use the same material sample
rules.observable_test: Compare normalized requests, storage, scripts, embeds, consent signals, and initiators across untouched, rejected, accepted, and granular states.
exceptions: A request under denied storage is not automatically a contradiction

rules.title: Withdrawal transition and later browser behaviour are observed
applicability_facts: An accepted state and visitor-facing preference mechanism are available
rules.observable_test: Accept, reopen preferences, withdraw in the same context, then record immediate and later requests and storage access.

expected_by_scenario.ACCEPTED_TO_WITHDRAWN: State transition and continued or stopped activity are both recorded without assuming already-loaded vendors stop

exceptions: No legal failure is inferred under the neutral profile

rules.title: Synthetic data reaches only an approved technical destination
applicability_facts: A safe registered interaction and synthetic canary are available
The destination's intended or unintended status is technically established
rules.observable_test: Detect a synthetic canary in memory at the browser request boundary and compare its minimized destination and parameter path with the approved interaction model.
exceptions: A same-origin or unknown-purpose destination remains inconclusive until its technical role is established
Submit-dependent leakage is NOT_TESTED without exact submission authorization

rules.title: Synthetic canary detection retains no canary value
applicability_facts: A safe registered interaction and synthetic canary are available
rules.observable_test: Detect the in-memory canary in outbound browser requests and retain only category, destination, safe parameter path, and NOT_RETAINED marker.

expected_by_scenario.REJECTED: Detection is recorded without value retention
expected_by_scenario.ACCEPTED: Detection is recorded without value retention

exceptions: Submit-dependent leakage is NOT_TESTED without exact submission authorization

rules.title: Observed products are compared with tracker declarations
applicability_facts: A public tracker-relevant declaration is available
rules.observable_test: Normalize observed vendor/product identities and compare them with public cookie or preference-center declarations.

expected_by_scenario.UNTOUCHED: All observed products remain in the comparison
expected_by_scenario.ACCEPTED: Interaction-triggered products remain in the comparison

exceptions: Declared-but-unobserved is NOT_VERIFIED rather than failed
